data.name: Through The Manor
data.detailed_description:
Build Your World

Point, click and drag your way to sprawling manors and intimate cottages. With a painterly aesthetic inspired by classic animation, every wall you place and window you frame contributes to a living work of art.

Step Inside

Experience the unique magic of human-scale exploration. Transition from architect to inhabitant at the press of a button to walk through your hallways and climb your own staircases. Every interior is fully functional and traversable, turning your structures into lived-in homes.

Walk the Grounds

Experience the true scale of your architecture from the ground up. Step out into the yard to gaze up at towering spires or wander through the shadows of the monuments you’ve constructed. The transition from aerial creator to world-traveler is seamless and instant.

A Living Canvas

Through The Manor’s procedural systems ensure every building looks beautiful while keeping your designs functional. Don't worry about the technicalities—just feel the vibes and create your perfect sanctuary to inhabit and explore.

data.short_description: A cozy building sandbox where you craft painterly structures and step inside them in 3rd person. Build whimsical manors, explore every room you design, and reside within your creations in this atmospheric, stress-free experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: For 720p: A graphics card with Vulkan 1.2 support and 2+ GB of video memory: Radeon R9 270 (driver 21.3.1), GeForce GTX 670 (at least Kepler architecture, driver 472.12 or newer), Intel Iris Xe, or similar.
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes, please
  • Additional Notes: A mouse with 2 buttons + scroll wheel is necessary for camera control.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: For 1080p: A graphics card with Vulkan 1.2 support and 4+ GB of video memory: Radeon RX 580, GeForce GTX 1060, Intel Arc A380, or similar.
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes, please
  • Additional Notes: A mouse with 2 buttons + scroll wheel is necessary for camera control.
